name: WdRevisionsMarkup
description: Specifies the extent of markup visible in the document, returned by and passed to the RevisionsFilter.Markup property.

constants.name: wdRevisionsMarkupNone
constants.description: Displays the final document with no markup visible.

constants.name: wdRevisionsMarkupSimple
constants.description: Displays the final document in simple markup: with revisions incorporated, but with no markup visible.

constants.name: wdRevisionsMarkupAll
constants.description: Displays the final document with all markup visible.
